contexts.text: If thou move thy graving tool upon it () = if from proprium. A graving tool = truth invented, thus from proprium; for a graving tool is an iron by which stones are cut and fitted into a form. This, therefore, is the proprium of man; for this makes adaptation, in order that the things of religion may appear in the form of truth. Instead of graving tool, there is elsewhere mentioned iron, and elsewhere axe. Illustrated.

He formed it with a graving tool () = from Own intelligence. (For) to form with a graving tool, when in relation to an idol, = to fit in false doctrine from Own intelligence, which is done by the application of the sense of the letter... to the favour of the loves of self and of the world. For, when these reign, the man is not in any enlightenment from Heaven; but he takes all things from his own intelligence, and confirms them from the sense of the letter... which he falsifies by a wrong application and a perverted interpretation; and he afterwards favours these things, because they are from himself.

By a graver, a hammer, and an axe, and, in general, by iron () is signified truth in its ultimate, and this is chiefly falsified from the proprium of man; for this truth is similar to the truth of the sense of the letter.
